messages:
lydia_sales: Quick sync — prospect 'Helix' wants a reserved capacity proposal + fallback plan. Peak target: ~3k RPS chat, mix ~65% short (~45 tokens) / 35% long (~700 tokens). They require AZ spread + preheat.

sam_se: Which models? That'll shift GPU count. Any session affinity/state requirements?

nina_ml: Plan is 7B quantized for main routes, 3B for low-latency. Rough perf on our runtime: 7B ~1.2M tok/s per GPU, 3B ~2.0M tok/s. Avg tokens/request ~0.65*45 + 0.35*700 = 261 -> ~783k tok/s at 3k RPS. Baseline ideal ~= 0.65 GPU. Ops margins -> recommend reserve 4 GPUs with AZ spread + 2 burst slots.

omar_eng: Ops notes: include autoscale policy: min_replicas=1/az, target_util=65%, scale_up when qps>80% for 30s, scale_down cooloff 5m. Preheat: 30-45m window with KV priming.

ops_bot: Perf sim summary: recommended reserved GPUs=4 (spread across 3 AZs), burst pool=2, expected p95 ~230-300ms depending on batching.

sam_se: Need a short contract line and pricing delta vs pure burst credits. I'll draft pricing options once you confirm numbers.

nina_ml: Fallback order: 1) route long responses to 3B (same region), 2) trim/max token cap reductions, 3) route to hosted multi-tenant in another region, 4) return retry-after envelope. Policy should include session_compatibility tags so conversations avoid semantic drift.

omar_eng: Add routing implementation: tag-based model_family, latency_class; fallback time_budget=350ms. Also include canary rollout for model upgrades to avoid regressions.

maya_security: Security check: they asked about KMS and audit retention for Dedicated. Provide paste-ready snippet?

ops_bot: Snippet: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure). Data plane encryption in transit and at rest. Audit logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM; retention configurable via enterprise add-on. Network isolation via VPC peering and private subnets."

lydia_sales: Actions: Nina/Omar confirm final GPU count + preheat steps by EOD; Sam to produce 2 pricing options (reserved 4+burst2 vs reserve 6); Maya to add KMS/audit blurb to questionnaire. We'll loop customer in after pricing. :thumbsup:
